citations.assessment: The complete teaching before the sages in the name of Rabbi Natan names Rabbi Chanina ben Uri. Heilprin’s own Chanina entry cites this locus.

The located chain reads Rabbi Chuna, Rabbi Uri, Rav Yosef, Rav Yehudah in Shmuel’s name. The source differs in order and title from this Heilprin entry. Heilprin’s Chuna entry identifies Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 2.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
